<module id="fsm">
    <description>Mealy FSM detection circuit that detects a single-bit input IN. When the input is 10011, output MATCH is 1, and MATCH is 0 in other cases. Support for continuous input and loop detection.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Input signal to the FSM.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="S0">State S0.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State S1.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State S2.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State S3.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State S4.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">State S5.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="current_state" type="reg" width_description="[2:0]">Current state register.</signal>
        <signal id="next_state" type="reg" width_description="[2:0]">Next state register.</signal>
        
        <always_comb>
            case(current_state)
                S0: next_state = IN ? S1 : S0;
                S1: next_state = !IN ? S2 : S1;
                S2: next_state = !IN ? S3 : S1;
                S3: next_state = IN ? S4 : S0;
                S4: next_state = IN ? S5 : S0;
                S5: next_state = IN ? S1 : S0;
                default: next_state = S0;
            endcase
        </always_comb>
        
        <always_ff @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if(RST) current_state <= S0;
            else current_state <= next_state;
        end
        
        assign MATCH = (current_state == S5 && IN == 1);
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on changes in IN, CLK, or RST
        always @(IN, CLK, RST) begin
            // Check if reset is active
            if (RST) begin
                MATCH = 0; // Set MATCH to 0 on reset
            end else begin
                // State transition logic
                case (current_state)
                    S0: begin
                        if (IN == 1) begin
                            current_state = S1; // Transition to state S1 if IN is 1
                        end else begin
                            current_state = S0; // Stay in state S0 if IN is not 1
                        end
                    end
                    
                    S1: begin
                        if (IN == 0) begin
                            current_state = S2; // Transition to state S2 if IN is 0
                        end else begin
                            current_state = S1; // Stay in state S1 if IN is not 0
                        end
                    end
                    
                    S2: begin
                        if (IN == 0) begin
                            current_state = S3; // Transition to state S3 if IN is 0
                        end else begin
                            current_state = S1; // Stay in state S1 if IN is not 0
                        end
                    end
                    
                    S3: begin
                        if (IN == 1) begin
                            current_state = S4; // Transition to state S4 if IN is 1
                        end else begin
                            current_state = S0; // Stay in state S0 if IN is not 1
                        end
                    end
                    
                    S4: begin
                        if (IN == 1) begin
                            current_state = S5; // Transition to state S5 if IN is 1
                        end else begin
                            current_state = S0; // Stay in state S0 if IN is not 1
                        end
                    end
                    
                    S5: begin
                        if (IN == 1) begin
                            current_state = S1; // Transition back to state S1 if IN is 1
                        end else begin
                            current_state = S0; // Stay in state S0 if IN is not 1
                        end
                    end
                    
                    default: current_state = S0; // Default state assignment
                endcase
                
                // Output logic based on current state
                if (current_state == S5 && IN == 1) begin
                    MATCH = 1; // Set MATCH to 1 if current state is S5 and IN is 1
                end else begin
                    MATCH = 0; // Otherwise, set MATCH to 0
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
